route.name: User Activities
route.description: Get the activities of a user on GitHub, based on the GitHub official RSS feed

parameters.number: Issue or pull number (if omitted: all)

parameters.order: Sort order by commit numbers, desc and asc (descending by default)
parameters.anon: Show anonymous users. Defaults to no, use any values for yes.

parameters.labels: a list of comma separated label names

parameters.state: the state of pull requests. Can be either `open`, `closed`, or `all`. Default: `open`.
parameters.labels: a list of comma separated label names

parameters.period: Time frame, selected from a repository's Pulse/Insights page. Possible values are: `daily`, `halfweekly`, `weekly`, or `monthly`. Default: `weekly`. If your RSS client supports it, consider aligning the polling frequency of the feed to the period.
